description: Source code implementing packaged printf functionality for Zephyr OS, including va_list handling, string packaging, and external formatting support.

methods.name: ptr_in_rodata
methods.description: Checks if an address is in the read-only data section.

methods.name: cbprintf_via_va_list
methods.description: Creates a va_list from a buffer for different architectures.

methods.name: get_package_len
methods.description: Calculates the length of a packaged string buffer.

methods.name: append_string
methods.description: Appends a string to a buffer via callback or calculates size.

methods.name: cbvprintf_package
methods.description: Formats a packaged string buffer into a variable argument list for printing.

methods.name: cbprintf_package
methods.description: Wrapper for cbvprintf_package with variadic arguments.

methods.name: cbpprintf_external
methods.description: Converts packaged data to external format and patches string pointers.

methods.name: is_fmt_spec
methods.description: Checks if a character might be a format specifier.

methods.name: is_ptr
methods.description: Determines if the nth argument in a format string is a pointer (%p).

methods.name: cbprintf_package_convert
methods.description: Converts a packaged buffer, optionally filtering or copying strings, into a different format.
